items.name: golden-hour
items.text: The warm, low-angled light of the long summer golden hour, casting extremely long and soft shadows.

items.name: backlit-rim-light
items.text: Strong, direct backlighting from a low sun, creating a brilliant, sharp rim-light effect that silhouettes the vehicle.

items.name: volumetric-god-rays
items.text: Hazy, atmospheric daylight with visible volumetric sunbeams (god rays).

items.name: overcast-softbox
items.text: Soft, perfectly even light from a bright but uniformly overcast sky, acting as a giant natural softbox.

items.name: high-key-studio
items.text: Flawless high-key studio lighting from massive softboxes and a cyclorama.

items.name: hard-spotlight
items.text: A dramatic, single, hard-edged spotlight in an otherwise dark studio.

items.name: storm-shafts
items.text: Gathering storm clouds stacked dark overhead, intense shafts of light breaking through onto the scene in high-contrast pools.
